overrides.prompt:
Create an exactly 10-second vertical 9:16 product video for the user-supplied shoe product name. Creative direction: a natural on-foot walking showcase with a calm, realistic commercial look. Use one adult wearer and a flat, dry, uncluttered walking surface. Keep the shoes as the clear subject; avoid dramatic posing or a fashion runway unless explicitly requested.. This prompt is text only; no uploaded image or AI image analysis is used.

PRODUCT ACCURACY: Use only details supported by the product name and visible scene. Keep the shoe silhouette, colour, pattern, visible markings, fastening and sole outline consistent across every shot. Do not invent materials, cushioning, grip, waterproofing, comfort, durability or performance claims. Do not add logos, accessories, extra shoes or readable text. Keep both feet anatomically plausible and grounded; no sliding, foot twisting, floating, duplicated footwear or shape changes.

STRICT OUTPUT RULES: exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16, one cohesive product video, no on-screen text, no captions, no added logos, no watermark, no morphing, no floating objects, no unrealistic transformations. Keep the product presentation consistent and finish with a clean hero frame.

PREMIUM STORYBOARD — EXACTLY 10 SECONDS:
0–2s | Establish the shoe: Start at a low three-quarter angle with the shoes clearly visible on the wearer's feet. Use a gentle camera push while keeping the full shoe outline readable.
2–6s | Walking action: The wearer takes two or three slow, natural steps on a flat surface. Track smoothly alongside the feet with believable heel-to-toe contact and weight transfer; no exaggerated movement.
6–8s | Visible detail: Move briefly closer to the visible upper, fastening or side profile. Show only supported details; do not force an unnatural foot turn to reveal the sole.
8–10s | Final hero: The wearer stops with both feet naturally planted. Hold a clean, steady view of the unchanged shoes and their silhouette.

CINEMATOGRAPHY & CONTINUITY: One coherent location, natural light, realistic contact shadows, restrained camera movement and clean transitions. No jumpy cuts, warping, artificial speed streaks, on-screen text, captions, added logos or watermarks. No dialogue or voice-over; use subtle instrumental music only if audio is supported, kept below natural ambience.

overrides.prompt:

PRODUCT LOCK: Match the reference for shape, colour, proportions, seams, hardware, handles and straps. Do not invent compartments, materials, logos, contents or accessories. Lift only by a visible handle or a supported part of the bag; if no safe grip is visible, use a gentle camera move instead. Keep the base supported until lift-off, with realistic weight and strap movement.

NO TEXT: No captions, added logos, watermark, morphing, floating parts, sudden redesign or impossible hand movement. No dialogue; subtle instrumental music only if supported.

STORYBOARD — EXACTLY 10 SECONDS:
0–2s | Tabletop establish: Show the complete bag resting on a clean table, three-quarter view, with its full outline visible.
2–6s | Pick-up: A single hand enters naturally and gently lifts the bag by an existing handle or supported grip. The bag clears the table once; no sudden tug or strap-only lifting unless the strap is visibly designed for it.
6–8s | Weight and detail: Hold the bag briefly just above or beside the table; let any visible strap settle naturally. Show one real seam, clasp or edge only if visible.
8–10s | Hero finish: Set the bag down gently in a stable position and hold the full product in frame.

Use one coherent setting, natural contact shadows and restrained camera motion. Keep hand anatomy, bag dimensions and hardware consistent; finish on a steady, undistorted hero frame.
